The "script" arguments should be passed `Variant()` instead of `Variant::NIL`. While the enum *technically* works in this context, the intent is to take a `Ref<Script>`.
```suggestion
	collection_writer_parser(Array(build_array(1, String("hello"), build_array(Variant())), Variant::NIL, "", Variant()), "[1, \"hello\", [null]]");
```
For some reason my IDE indented this by itself. Thanks for pointing it out!
I probably might have copy-pasted from the `type` argument. But this makes sense.
